Type: three-seat nailhead sofa

Style: modern, classic, contemporary

Shape: low track arms, three back cushions, long single bench seat cushion, nailhead trim on arm fronts, exposed wood plinth, tapered square legs, long and tailored

Goes with: dark wood, warm white walls, brass accents; classic or modern living rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Westport Modern Nailhead Upholstered Sofa, 87"W, Linen
product.description: Elevate your style with this head-turning modern sofa. A long down-blend bench seat is combined with back cushions that are reversible. Nailhead trim on the arms and across the sides, along with the exposed wood base, adds extra sophistication. 87"W x 37.75''D x33''H 60% cotton/40% linen fabric; metal nailhead trim; wood legs. Removable, reversible back cushions. Corner clips keep bench seat firmly in place. No assembly required. Vacuum or wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
